name: The Hologram Garden of Lost Songs
description: A serene garden where holographic plants grow, each one playing a faint, ghostly melody from a song that has been forgotten by the world.
prompt: A peaceful and melancholic futuristic scene of a garden bathed in soft, ambient light. The garden is filled with unique, crystalline plants and flowers, but instead of leaves and petals, each plant projects a thin, shimmering holographic ribbon into the air. These ribbons form into delicate, ghostly images of musical notes, lyrics, and abstract shapes that pulse and flow like smoke. Faint, ethereal melodies can almost be heard emanating from each plant. The plants themselves are a mix of organic and geometric forms—some look like blooming metallic flowers, others like tall, branching crystals. The ground is covered in soft, reflective moss. The atmosphere is contemplative, beautiful, and tinged with longing. Highly detailed digital art with a focus on light, transparency, and subtle color palettes.
caption: Every forgotten song finds a home here, blooming in light and lingering in the air. Can you hear your favorite lost tune? 🎵👻
